comment: #612 L2: the 7 presets of `lights` (lights <preset>) on the L1 shadows scene (cartoon and ligand sticks, metal_shadows 1), recoloured grey80 (a neutral subject), with metal_raytrace 0 and 1: 14 images. Rendered by #613 (spot shading), which posts the contact sheet; before #613 nothing in rendering reads the rig. The frozen harness (render.py) installs its own 3-light rig for "rig": "on" by calling cmd.set_lights after each scene's lines. The extra lines wrap cmd.set_lights once per process (hasattr guard: the app runs the script twice): while cmd._l612_preset names a preset, the harness's call applies that preset with cmd.lights instead. `lights` reaches the rig through pymol.lighting.set_lights, never cmd.set_lights, so the wrapper cannot recurse. The view is set before the rig block, so the spotlight's off-centre aim resolves to the same world point on both runs. Checked in CI by TestSceneFiles (testing/tests/raymol/lighting_commands.py). Follow-up (#613's F4): first-class post-rig lines in render.py.
extra: cmd.set_lights = lambda rig, _c=cmd: _c.lights(_c._l612_preset) if getattr(_c, '_l612_preset', None) else _c._l612_set(rig)
